description: Implement the mobile + accessibility pass across the WHOLE site: (A) a shared prefers-reduced-motion hook/util wired consistently to gate/scale camera nudges, idle/ambient motion, wardrobe autoRotate, and landing-page CSS animations; (B) responsive layouts usable at 390x844 with no horizontal scroll and the controls panel never covering the canvas, across the landing page and all four demos; (C) a full keyboard path with visible focus through composer/chips/send, pet buttons/naming, wardrobe menu, and the QualityToggle, plus a keyboard/AT-reachable equivalent (or verified redundant path) for the WS3 clickable 3D props; (D) a meaningful text alternative for each canvas. Reduced-motion must GATE/SCALE motion only — never rewrite pinned pose/transform/camera-framing constants. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: REDUCED-MOTION HOOK: Add a shared client hook, e.g. components/three/useReducedMotion.ts (or lib/useReducedMotion.ts), that reads window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'), returns a boolean, subscribes to changes, and is SSR-safe (returns false / no window access during static prerender). Keep it three-free so it can be imported by both scene modules and DOM widgets. This adds NO new dependency.

SCENE MOTION GATING (chef/coach/pet/wardrobe *Scene.tsx): Thread the reduced-motion preference into each scene (read the hook at the scene wrapper and pass a prop, or read it inside the scene module). When reduced motion is ON: disable/skip the CameraRig nudge (chef/coach/wardrobe) so the camera holds its pinned framing; damp idle/ambient motion to rest — skip or freeze the ambient particles (ChefScene wisp, AtelierMotes), the avatar idle bob/sway (coach/pet/chef gesture idle), and set wardrobe OrbitControls autoRotate={false}. CRITICAL: do this by GATING the per-frame offsets/amplitudes to zero (or early-returning before writing offsets), NOT by editing the pinned rest/pose/camera-position/target constants. Do not change ACESFilmic tone mapping, exposure, lighting rigs, or the VRM tint pipeline. When reduced motion is OFF, behavior is exactly as today. Verify interactions still route through the existing engines/state (a click still produces the same engine output; only the motion response is damped).

CANVAS TEXT ALTERNATIVES: Improve the accessible description of each scene's Canvas. chef/coach/pet Canvas already have role='img' + a short aria-label — replace the terse labels with meaningful descriptions of what the scene shows (e.g. chef: 'Animated 3D chef avatar in chef whites that waves and speaks as it replies'; coach: 'Animated 3D gym coach that bobs and gestures while giving workout advice'; pet: 'Animated 3D schnauzer that reacts to feeding, play, sleep and cleaning'). The wardrobe Canvas (components/wardrobe/WardrobeScene.tsx) currently has NO role/aria-label — add role='img' and a meaningful aria-label (e.g. 'Rotating 3D avatar wearing the currently selected top, bottoms, shoes and hair; drag to rotate, scroll to zoom'). Keep labels content-accurate and concise.

LANDING PAGE CSS ANIMATIONS: Honor reduced motion for the tailwind CSS animations on app/page.tsx (animate-scan, animate-ticker, animate-marquee, animate-emberPulse, animate-ringSpin, animate-floatY). Prefer a CSS-only global rule in app/globals.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *,*::before,*::after{ animation-duration:0.001ms!important; animation-iteration-count:1!important; transition-duration:0.001ms!important; scroll-behavior:auto!important; } } so ALL CSS animations/transitions are neutralized when the user prefers reduced motion (this also covers the loading spinners and any hover translate). Confirm this does not break layout (elements that rely on the marquee/ticker for horizontal position still show their content statically). Do not delete the keyframes.

MOBILE / RESPONSIVE PASS (390x844, no horizontal scroll, panel not over canvas): For each demo widget verify and fix the small-phone layout. Chef/coach/pet already use flex-col (stage on top) below md: — confirm at 390px the stage keeps a real min-height and the panel sits BELOW it (not overlaying) and nothing overflows horizontally. Check the demo page wrappers: chef/coach/pet/wardrobe pages set fixed min-heights (e.g. chef min-h-[600px], wardrobe minHeight:760) — ensure the widget fits within its container at 390px without pushing content sideways. For WardrobeBuilder the wide layout is a 3-col lg:grid that stacks below lg: (stage order-1, then menus) — verify the option-card menus and swatch rows wrap and scroll rather than widening the page at 390px. For the LANDING page (app/page.tsx already has overflow-x-hidden on <main>) verify no child (hero image, ticker/marquee rails, ringSpin SVG, project gallery grid, footer) causes horizontal overflow at 390px; fix any offending fixed widths with responsive classes. The goal per route+width: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth.

KEYBOARD PATH + VISIBLE FOCUS: Ensure a keyboard-only user can Tab through, in a sensible order, every interactive control with a VISIBLE focus indicator: chef/coach composer input -> suggestion chips -> Send (and the mute toggle + QualityToggle radios); pet Feed/Play/Sleep/Clean buttons -> name input -> Save (+ QualityToggle); wardrobe option-card buttons + colour swatches + custom-colour input + animation radios (+ QualityToggle). Most controls already have focus rings; standardize on a clearly VISIBLE focus-visible style everywhere (add focus-visible ring classes where missing, e.g. any control relying only on focus:outline-none without a ring, and the wardrobe option-card/swatch buttons). Do not remove existing labels/aria.

WS3 CLICKABLE-PROP KEYBOARD EQUIVALENT: The WS3 3D affordances (chef onSampleDishClick -> send('Suggest a recipe'); pet onPetClick -> doAction('play'); wardrobe cycleCategory on garment click) are click-only on the canvas. Verify each has an equivalent reachable by keyboard/AT via the existing DOM controls: chef 'Suggest a recipe' suggestion chip, pet 'Play' button, wardrobe option-card buttons per category. Where the redundant DOM path fully covers the intent, DOCUMENT that in findings (no new control needed). If any intent is ONLY reachable by the canvas click, add a keyboard/AT-reachable DOM control that routes through the SAME handler (no parallel logic path). Do not invent a new state path.

GATE: run `npm run lint` (only the font warning allowed) and `npm run build` (static export succeeds; all five routes still prerender; WebGL/DOM stays behind next/dynamic {ssr:false}). Fix any errors introduced.

Record in findings: the exact reduced-motion wiring (file + what each scene/CSS gates), each canvas's final aria-label text, the per-widget keyboard tab order, the WS3 clickable-prop redundancy verification, and confirmation that WS1/WS2/WS3 invariants are untouched (no re-eager preload, quality.ts/QualityToggle still the only quality control, ACESFilmic + rigs + VRM tint untouched, interactions still engine-routed).
acceptance_criteria: A single shared, SSR-safe reduced-motion hook/util exists and is the one source of the preference; it uses window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') and adds no dependency.

With reduced motion ON: camera nudges (chef/coach/wardrobe) hold the pinned framing, ambient particles + avatar idle bob/sway are frozen/skipped, wardrobe autoRotate is false, and landing-page CSS animations are neutralized; with it OFF, motion is identical to today. Pinned pose/transform/camera constants are unchanged (verified by diff).
All four scene Canvases expose role='img' with a MEANINGFUL, content-accurate aria-label (wardrobe gains one it previously lacked).

At 390x844 on the landing page and all four demos, document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth (no horizontal scroll) and the controls panel does not cover the canvas; the desktop 1280x900 layout is unchanged/correct.

Every interactive control across the four widgets + QualityToggle is reachable by keyboard in a sensible order with a visible focus indicator; each WS3 canvas-click affordance has a documented keyboard/AT-reachable equivalent through the same handler.
`npm run lint` clean except the one expected font warning; `npm run build` static export succeeds with all five routes prerendered.

WS1/WS2/WS3 invariants preserved: no re-eager asset preload, chunk split + SceneLoader/useProgress intact, quality.ts + single QualityToggle remain the only quality control, ACESFilmic tone mapping + lighting rigs + VRM tint pipeline untouched, interactions still routed through the chef/coach engines + pet state + wardrobeOptions.
verification: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run lint && npm run build.

git diff main -- components/chef/ChefScene.tsx components/coach/CoachScene.tsx components/pet/PetScene.tsx components/wardrobe/WardrobeScene.tsx to confirm motion is GATED (offsets zeroed / early-returned) and NO pinned pose/camera/tone-mapping/light/tint constants changed.
Rebuild and re-run the FEAT-001 viewport harness at 390x844 for all five routes; confirm scrollWidth<=innerWidth for each (JSON noHorizontalScroll true).
grep that quality.ts / QualityToggle.tsx remain the only quality control and that asset() still wraps any URL touched; confirm no new eager preload was added.
findings:
DONE on branch a11y/mobile-accessibility (not pushed). Gate: `npm run lint` -> exactly one pre-existing @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning in app/layout.tsx (0 errors, 0 other warnings); `npm run build` -> clean static export, all five routes prerendered. Full AFTER writeup: docs/a11y/AFTER.md.

(A) REDUCED-MOTION WIRING: New shared hook components/three/useReducedMotion.ts -- three-free, SSR-safe, built on useSyncExternalStore reading window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') (server snapshot false, subscribes to OS change). No new dependency. Read once per widget wrapper (ChefChatbot, CoachChatbot, VirtualPet, WardrobeBuilder each add `const reducedMotion = useReducedMotion()`) and passed as a `reducedMotion` prop into the scene (WardrobeBuilder threads it via the memoized sceneProps). GATING per scene (all by zeroing per-frame offsets / early-return / not rendering ambient nodes -- NO pinned pose/camera/tone/light/tint constant edited): CHEF -- CameraRig pulse->0 (holds PINNED_CAM/PINNED_LOOK); SteamWisps not rendered; SampleDishProp idle sine-bob + continuous spin dropped (hover lift kept); Avatar arm-gesture gTarget->0 (arms ease to captured rest); lip-sync jaw still tracks speech. COACH -- CameraRig pulse->0; Avatar early-returns to rest (energy=0, position/rotation zeroed incl. breathing bob); FloorShimmer not rendered; KettlebellProp idle bob dropped. PET -- CameraRig pulse->0; Pet early-returns to rest (energy+actionEnv zeroed, position/rotation set 0 -- freezes breathing/bob/wiggle/droop AND the feed/play/sleep/clean one-shot hop); DustMotes not rendered. WARDROBE -- OrbitControls autoRotate forced false (autoRotate = !reducedMotion && animation==='rest'); CameraRig garment-change nudge pulse->0; AtelierMotes not rendered; explicitly-selected clips + drag/zoom still work. CSS: app/globals.css gains @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ *,*::before,*::after{ animation-duration:.001ms!important; animation-iteration-count:1!important; transition-duration:.001ms!important; scroll-behavior:auto!important; } } -- neutralizes ALL landing CSS animations (animate-scan/ticker/marquee/emberPulse/ringSpin/floatY), SceneLoader spinners, hover translate; keyframes NOT deleted; content stays at start position (no layout loss).

(D) CANVAS ARIA (all role='img'): chef 'Animated 3D chef avatar in chef whites that gestures and speaks while giving cooking answers'; coach 'Animated 3D gym coach that bobs and gestures while giving workout advice'; pet 'Animated 3D schnauzer dog that reacts to feeding, play, sleep and cleaning'; wardrobe (previously had NEITHER role nor label) NOW role='img' + 'Rotating 3D avatar wearing the currently selected top, bottoms, shoes and hair; drag to rotate, scroll to zoom'.

(B) MOBILE 390x844: measure-viewports.mjs on built out/ -> scrollWidth==innerWidth (390/390 and 1280/1280) on ALL FIVE routes, noHorizontalScroll=true (docs/a11y/after-*-{390,1280}.{png,json}). Layouts already sound: chef/coach/pet flex-col below md: (stage on top w/ real min-height h-[38-42%]+min-h, panel flex-1 BELOW not overlaying); wardrobe 3-col lg:grid stacks below lg: (stage order-1 min-h-[420px], menus order-2/3 with overflow-y-auto option lists + flex-wrap swatch rows); landing <main> keeps overflow-x-hidden, no child overflow. No layout constants needed changing to hold no-scroll; matches FEAT-001 finding that the real 390 issue was cramping, not overflow.

(C) KEYBOARD + VISIBLE FOCUS: tab orders -- CHEF/COACH: QualityToggle radios -> mute toggle -> suggestion chips -> composer input -> Send. PET: QualityToggle -> Feed/Play/Sleep/Clean -> name input -> Save. WARDROBE: QualityToggle -> left menu (Shoes,Hair) option cards + swatches + custom-colour picker -> animation radios -> right menu (Top,Bottoms) cards + swatches + picker. focus-visible rings ADDED where missing (all in WardrobeBuilder.tsx): option-card buttons, colour-swatch buttons, custom-colour <label> (focus-within), animation radio buttons -- all `focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#2c2a26] focus-visible:ring-offset-1`. Chef/coach/pet controls + QualityToggle already had rings (kept). No labels/aria removed.

WS3 CLICKABLE-PROP KEYBOARD REDUNDANCY (verified; NO new control added, all route through the SAME handler): chef onSampleDishClick->send('Suggest a recipe') covered by the 'Suggest a recipe' greeting suggestion chip (same send()); pet onPetClick->doAction('play') covered by the 'Play' action button (same doAction); wardrobe garment click cycleCategory(outfit|bottom) routes through setOption, and the per-category option-card buttons call the SAME setOption so every garment is keyboard-selectable.

WS1/WS2/WS3 INVARIANTS PRESERVED: no re-eager asset preload (git diff shows zero preload additions in components); chunk split + SceneLoader/useProgress fallback intact; asset() still wraps every public URL (WardrobeScene URL block untouched); quality.ts + single QualityToggle remain the ONLY quality control; ACESFilmic tone mapping + lighting rigs + VRM tint pipeline untouched (git diff main on the four *Scene.tsx shows only additive reduced-motion comments/branches + aria-label text + autoRotate gate -- NO numeric pose/camera-position/target/framing/tone/light/shadow-map/tint constant changed); interactions still engine-routed (chef/coach engines, lib/pet state, wardrobeOptions) -- only MOTION damped. NOTE: unrelated untracked dirs (.agents/tasks/task-pet-motion-gallery, task-virtual-pet, one visual-lighting review .md) belong to other workstreams and were left unstaged.
